title: What is AI?
objective: By the end of this lesson, you will be able to say what AI is, how it differs from a program of fixed rules, and why it can be wrong.

sections.title: What is AI?
sections.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is software that does tasks that usually need human thinking, such as recognising speech, translating languages, or suggesting the next word you might type.

sections.title: Rules and learning
sections.text: Some programs follow rules that a person wrote. Many AI systems instead learn patterns from a lot of examples. A spam filter learns from thousands of emails that people marked as spam or not spam.

sections.title: AI you already meet
sections.text: You already meet AI in maps that find quick routes, cameras that find faces, phone keyboards that suggest words, and tutors like the one in this lab.

sections.title: AI can be wrong
sections.text: AI can make mistakes. It does not have feelings, and it does not understand the world the way a person does. Check important answers with your teacher or a trusted source.

check_questions.prompt: Which of these is an example of AI?
options: A phone suggesting the next word as you type
check_questions.explanation: Suggesting the next word uses patterns learned from lots of examples of text.

misconception.3: A paper map does not learn or change.

check_questions.prompt: How does a spam filter usually learn?
options: From thousands of emails marked spam or not spam
By asking each person what they like
By being told every spam email in advance
check_questions.explanation: It finds patterns in many examples that people already labelled.

misconception.1: It learns from labelled examples, not by asking each person.
misconception.2: New spam appears all the time, so it must learn patterns.
misconception.3: Random guessing would not learn anything.

check_questions.prompt: An AI tutor tells you something important. What should you do?
options: Check it with a teacher or a trusted source
check_questions.explanation: AI can be wrong, so check important things with a teacher or a trusted source.

misconception.0: AI can make mistakes, so do not trust it completely.
misconception.2: Answers are often useful. Just check the important ones.
misconception.3: Deleting it does not help you learn.
